theme: Light & Dark Mode (Toggle). Archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Organic warm tones for Trust.

typography.body: Satoshi or IBM Plex Sans - leading-relaxed.
rules: No Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings.
Headings > 32px must use tracking-tight.
Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not exceed text-6xl for Hero H1. Use fluid typography.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: The jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
typography.installation: Add fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare in index.css

colors.primary: Deep Obsidian / Midnight Blue (#0A0A0A or #0F172A) for Trust and Authority
colors.accent: Signal Red (#FF3B30) or Electric Blue (#007AFF) for High-contrast actions
rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint neutral grays slightly with blue (cool) or orange (warm).
95% of UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Text contrast must meet APCA / WCAG AA standards. Explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Use Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 + backdrop-blur-xl).

surfaces.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70 or bg-black/60, saturate-150, 1px delicate inner stroke).
surfaces.dashboards: Flat solid surfaces, subtle 1px border (border-border), no muddy shadows. Hover state: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces.modals: High-end glass or solid background with sharp contrasts.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows. Crisp edges via semi-transparent borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-black/5 or border-white/10) to ground soft components.

marketing.config: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
marketing.usage: Use overlapping elements and pure HTML + Tailwind for structure. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for marketing layouts.

dashboard.config: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
dashboard.usage: Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children to match heights.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: p-6 to p-12. Avoid cramped designs. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
rules: Mobile-first responsive always.
Direct Children Only for grids. If animating, motion.div must be the direct child.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., extra padding for icons).
Do not center-align everything. Use left alignment for dense content, paragraphs, and forms.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, click states).
Use specific properties for transitions (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s). NO 'transition: all'.
Entrance animations staggered for lists (using framer-motion).
Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Meaningful animations should not interfere with keyboard focus.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
High contrast focus states.
Screen-reader friendly tables.
Proper aria-hidden attributes on decorative elements.

rules: Hero image overlay max opacity: bg-black/50. If the image isn't clearly visible, you are wasting it. Use gradient overlays instead of flat blankets.
Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile.

component_strategy.marketing: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS (div, section) for layouts to allow overlapping and asymmetry. Use customized Shadcn only for interactive logic (forms, inputs).
component_strategy.dashboard: Heavily utilize Shadcn components (tables, calendars, select, dropdowns). Customize spacings and borders to match the brand. Go cardless, flat, rectangular, dense.

specific_components.navigation: MUST have a visible navigation bar on desktop with Logo + Links + Primary CTA. Do not hide behind a hamburger menu on desktop.
specific_components.footer: Contrast Shift (Light body = Dark Footer). Massive space (py-20 or py-32). Include one massive typographical element.
specific_components.forms: Never use native input or select. Always use Shadcn Input/Select/Form.

instructions_to_main_agent: CREATE high-end, DISTINCTIVE frontends. Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Ensure all components and pages use standard JavaScript/JSX (.js/.jsx extensions). Do NOT create .tsx or .ts files.
DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define properties.
DO NOT apply global text-align: center on the App container.
Create depth with z-index hierarchies and glassmorphism.
Use modern, sharp or pill-shaped buttons with hover animations.
Do NOT use placeholder URLs or emojis as icons. Use the provided image URLs.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements for testing.
For the dashboards (Customer, Provider, Admin), ensure high-density layouts with clear navigation hierarchy.
For the AI & WhatsApp integration hubs, prioritize clean, chat-style interfaces with clear status indicators.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx`.
